content.text:
The site looked different because the web font stopped loading. I fixed it, and all 12 visual snapshots (6 pages at desktop and phone size) now match the approved baselines.

The `@font-face` rule in `site/css/tokens.css` pointed at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the directory is `site/fonts/`. The font request failed, so every page fell back to the system font. I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't confirm from history when the path broke. I did confirm it by running the visual tests before the fix (12 of 12 changed) and after it (12 of 12 pass). I didn't run the functional tests. I changed nothing else and approved no baselines, since the originals were correct.

STATUS: DONE
